newsitem.title: UK: London Electricity dips on newspaper reports.
newsitem.headline: London Electricity dips on newspaper reports.

text.p: Shares in London Electricity Plc dipped on Tuesday after newspaper reports named it as the utility with which Northern Electric planned to merge its electricity and gas supply businesses as part of a bid defence.
By 0844 GMT London Electricity stock was down seven pence at 640. Northern Electric was down eight pence at 603-1/2.

Northern Electric said on Tuesday it planned to merge its electricity and gas supply businesses with another regional electricity company (rec) in an attempt to ward off a hostile 782 million stg bid from US-based CE Electric.
Northern declined to name the other rec but a number of newspapers, including the Financial Times, said on Wednesday its potential partner was London Electricity.

Analysts on Tuesday said they did not expect the defence to succeed and Trade and Industry Secretary Ian Lang will decide whether to refer the bid to the Monopolies and Mergers Commission in the next few days.
